question: What measurement is prescribed for the span from the armpit-line to the armpit end?
premises: The starting point is the armpit-line.
The endpoint is the armpit end.
The prescribed extent is eight measures.
inference: The span from the armpit-line to the armpit end measures eight units.
uncertainties: The exact physical referent of hikkāsūtra in this iconometric context is inferred from context.
plain_english: From the armpit-line to the end of the armpit is stated to be eight measures.
